summary: This bill amends the Energy Policy and Conservation Act to require the Secretary of Energy to conduct a full fuel cycle analysis for energy efficiency standards for natural gas water heaters, furnaces, boilers, and kitchen appliances, certify that new rules will not significantly shift consumers to electric alternatives, and ensure these rules do not apply to small manufacturers or limit appliance features.

scores.thoughts: This bill aims to prevent a shift from gas to electric appliances by modifying energy efficiency standards and requiring specific analyses. This would likely lead to less environmental protection by hindering the adoption of potentially more energy-efficient electric alternatives and continuing reliance on natural gas, which contributes to greenhouse gas emissions.
